dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'd like to ask for directions...

dialogues.speaker: Boncza
dialogues.text: Oh hey, you're new here, aint'cha? Good thing you ran into me. Nasha Town's far from a safe haven, and if you go around asking questions like that, you'll be eating more scams than krumkakes.

dialogues.speaker: Boncza
dialogues.text: If you're here on vacation, I recommend taking a walk around the square in front of the merchant guild. The scenery's whatever, but you can swing by "Mead-Boy" and snag some Snezhnayan souvenirs to bring back home. Lots of people do that.

dialogues.speaker: Boncza
dialogues.text: If you're strapped for Mora and looking to amend that, I recommend you head to The Flagship and look for Kruchek. I hear that the jobs he offers pay pretty well!

dialogues.speaker: Boncza
dialogues.text: If you're here for business, though, you should make a beeline for the Voynich Guild. Get the latest market scoop from them before stocking up on anything. That way, you won't make any losses!
